Independently rebuilt the complete release Gate through build_gate_report: normalized JSON exactly matches the persisted Gate, 92/92 matched; all 92 case records and Corpus expectations remain unchanged from baseline. Its successor is blocked by reported remote SSH host-key/authentication failures, with no environment repair. That independent Executor limitation does not block this Compiler-only local Metal release, but must remain explicit and CUDA use/main merge must await its separate successor acceptance.
